[P2] M34 highway (Tajikistan)

[P4] Vakhsh, Tajikistan

[P5] Capital punishment in Tajikistan
Capital punishment in Tajikistan is allowed by Article 18 of the 1999 Constitution of Tajikistan , which provides : The last known execution took place in 2004 . That same year , a moratorium was issued on capital punishment by president Emomali Rahmon . Tajikistan is not signatory to the Second Optional Protocol to the International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights , which aims to abolish the death penalty .
